caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object with intricate scrollwork and symmetrical design, colored in shades of brown to resemble polished wood grain. The object stands upright on a flat, rectangular base with rounded edges. The central structure is vertical, featuring a taller, undulating silhouette that rises to a rounded peak at the top. Flanking this central section are two symmetrical scroll-like arms, each curling outward and back in toward the center, ending in decorative, spindle-shaped finials or posts. The arms are supported by additional ornamental forms that connect back to the base, all featuring similar wood grain texture and shading to add depth. The background is an off-white, plain surface, with faint pencil marks and a small sketch or signature on the left side. The overall composition is centered, and the entire wooden structure casts a light gray, diffuse shadow to the right, indicating a light source from the left.
title: Mahogany Shelf
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
